decisions.reason: The existing message-184 MODIFY already requires the fiat-buyer FAQ section to explain that the confirmation email contains the mint number serving as the referral code.
The existing message-184 MODIFY already includes the mint number and referral code in the required mint-confirmation email contents.
Requiring the referral code in the confirmation email does not change the About-page content requirement.
Adding a referral-code display location does not change commission allocation when a mint has no referral code.
Displaying the existing referral code in the confirmation email does not change coded-referral commission triggers, recipients, amounts, or payouts.
The new confirmation-email display requirement does not alter how referral identity or other NFT state behaves after transfer.
The referral-code email display change does not alter Transak conversion, wallet provisioning, supported payment methods, or mint destination.
Adding the referral code to the confirmation email does not change ticket issuance counts or the recipient NFT.
Confirmation-email referral-code content is independent of the one-time-code authentication method and dashboard access behavior.
The referral-code display change does not affect the PDF.js reader engine or its dashboard and email-linked entry points.
Displaying the referral code in a confirmation email does not change SIWE authentication users, protected flows, or scope.
The referral-code display requirement does not change automatic prize transfer behavior or restore any claim control.
